purpose: Define deterministic/manual composition, derivation lineage and versioned import/export behavior for GCL reusable construction records without granting runtime or canon authority.

input_requirements: Every input template is identified by stable template_id plus exact template_version.
Every source-bound slot preserves source identity/version and current authorization/entitlement context.
Required compatibility constraints are evaluated before a composition result is considered ready-to-use.
Unknown or unresolved required inputs remain explicit and are never invented to make composition succeed.

operations.meaning: Bind an explicit compatible value to an unresolved or intentionally open slot.
Replace a replaceable slot value while retaining prior-value lineage.
Append a compatible item to a repeatable slot without changing unrelated items.
Remove one optional repeatable value while preserving an operation receipt.
Choose an explicit declared variant; absence of a compatible variant remains unresolved.
Apply a versioned transformation whose authority and compatibility requirements are explicitly declared.
Use an authorized output of one compatible reusable template as an input to another declared slot.
Preserve GM choice by marking an optional/open slot without fabricating a value.

forbidden_implicit_operations: hidden-information retrieval outside the initiating subject's authorized projection
collapse of independent encounter pressure dimensions into a universal scalar

deterministic_manual_path.rule: Given the same exact template versions, explicit slot values, compatibility context and ordered operation list, the structural composition result before freeform text elaboration must be reproducible.
deterministic_manual_path.freeform_boundary: Human-authored or optional AI prose elaboration may vary, but it must remain separately attributable and may not alter the deterministic structural receipt without a new explicit operation.

composition_receipt.digest_rule: Digest proves the recorded composition package/receipt identity only; it does not prove balance, fairness, canon or runtime acceptance.

allowed: fill explicitly AI-eligible open slots as candidates

authority_declaration.rule: Importing a package never turns a GCL record into Campaign, Scene, Encounter, Session or canon truth. External canon status is only referenced when supported by external owning-domain evidence.

rules: Same stable ID plus same version plus same digest is idempotent.
Same stable ID plus same version plus different digest is a blocking integrity conflict; neither record silently wins.
Different versions may coexist when lifecycle/lineage permits and must remain distinguishable.
Unknown dependencies remain unresolved; the importer may preserve a disabled/proposal record but may not fabricate the dependency.

Restricted or unauthorized source references are omitted or retained as safe unresolved references according to the importing authority; hidden details are never leaked through error text, counts or facets.

gcl_json_v1: array order preserved where semantic order exists
set-like arrays sorted by stable identifier before hashing
digest field excluded from its own digest input
digest.boundary: The digest is an integrity identifier, not an authority or quality certificate.

export_views.rule: Contains only fields the exporting subject is authorized and entitled to export.
Carries the authorized rapid-use projection plus required warnings, unresolved requirements, provenance and authority label.
Carries replaceable slots, dependencies, transformation/composition points, provenance and authority label.
Carries safe discovery metadata without protected template details or hidden source content.

downstream_adapter_rules: Consumers must use explicit adapters/contracts; a GCL record is never silently reinterpreted as a consumer's live aggregate.
F005-style consumers create local placements/bindings with their own stable IDs and provenance rather than mutating GCL source records.
F012-style consumers may use GCL encounter material as composition inputs but retain their own validation, analysis, approval, snapshot and Scene-attachment authority.
Consumers may narrow projections for permissions/entitlements but may not broaden source authority through GCL.
Adapters must preserve unresolved requirements, warnings, uncertainty and lineage material needed for responsible human review.
